description: Stations du canevas géodésique de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Cette couche de points constitue un des éléments du canevas géodésique de Rennes Métropole. Pour information, un canevas est un ensemble de points géodésiques connus en position et servant d'ossature à la réalisation d'un levé topographique. Coverage: Rennes Métropole en accès libre. The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Its keywords include altitude, referentiels-geographiques. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2019-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
